final: WITH quantities AS (SELECT order_id, CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(product_quantity), '') AS REAL) AS quantity FROM Order_Items), overall AS (SELECT AVG(quantity) AS overall_avg FROM quantities) SELECT q.order_id, AVG(q.quantity) AS average_quantity, AVG(q.quantity) - o.overall_avg AS difference_from_overall FROM quantities q CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL GROUP BY q.order_id ORDER BY difference_from_overall DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
